summary: Frontend test of redesigned Stok Barang screen (/stok-barang) + Dashboard retest at 390x844 and 360x740 using seeded token test_dash_ui_token. All requested flows WORK: navigation (Dashboard buka-stok-barang, screen-back, direct URL back -> /dashboard), summary math (HPP tersedia Rp70.000, HPP rusak Rp20.000, tersedia 10, rusak 3 on seed - all match FIFO formula), form toggle/title, Picker jenis/supplier, new jenis, live Total HPP, Tambah (new row + merge same jenis+HPP+supplier, separate row for different HPP), Kurangi (rusak saved with FIFO HPP, sisa hint updates), all 3 validation toasts, search (jenis/supplier/keterangan, chip counts update, clear button, empty state), chips Semua/Masuk/Keluar-rusak filtering and stok-item-count, edit sheet (prefill, invalid toast, save jml/hpp/jual/supplier with awal adjusted, close X / scrim, hapus -> batal / ya), rusak sheet (details, close, hapus -> stock returned), Download on web produced valid Stok_Barang_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx (rows verified by unzipping) and empty-filter toast, persistence after reload, Dashboard numbers (Stok barang 3 jenis / 9 pohon, Stok sekarang, Nilai stok sekarang) update consistently. Dashboard profile sheet opens/closes, header chip fits at 360px, no horizontal overflow at 360/390. No page errors. Ekspor unduh validation toasts work ('Pilih minimal 1 pesanan', missing-cells message); actual Ekspor download not triggered because seeded orders have required cells empty, but it uses the same exportSheet() path verified on Stok download. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Only minor logic/data-integrity issues found.

integration_issues.issue: Deleting the only belanja row of a jenis (e.g., TEST_C) leaves its rusak records (and pesanan items) orphaned: rusak cards still listed, still counted in 'Keluar (rusak)' and 'Total HPP Keluar/rusak', still exported; sisaStok for that jenis becomes negative. No warning when the row already has stock consumed. Suggest: warn/block deletion when row is consumed, or also offer to remove related rusak. Reference: /app/frontend/app/stok-barang.tsx:364-368

No validation that new Jumlah >= already consumed (terjual+rusak) for that jenis; lowering jml makes jenis-level sisa negative while row pill shows 0. Reference: /app/frontend/app/stok-barang.tsx:536-553

issues: Name '<jenis> (Keluar)' is truncated already at 390px for short names ('TEST_A (Kelu…') because Rusak tag + 'Rusak: N Pohon' pill share the row; real jenis names (e.g. 'Aglonema Red Sumatra') will show almost nothing. Consider moving Rusak tag below name or allowing 2 lines.

action_items: Handle deletion of a belanja row whose stock is already consumed (warn/block, or cascade to related rusak) so 'Keluar (rusak)' and HPP rusak don't count orphan records (stok-barang.tsx:364)
EditSheet.save: validate new jml >= consumed qty for the jenis (stok-barang.tsx:536)
Validate integer quantities: pers-jml / edit-jml accept '2.5' or '1e3' on web (Number() > 0 passes) -> fractional pohon saved (stok-barang.tsx:62-107, 536)

Jenis matching: willMerge is case-insensitive but sisaStok/stokFIFO/jenisList are case-sensitive; adding '+ Jenis baru' 'test_a' with different HPP creates a duplicate jenis differing only by case - normalise or reject duplicates (stok-barang.tsx:47-52, calc.ts)
Rusak card name truncation (see design_issues); add testID to Ekspor 'Pilih semua'
Optional: after Tambah, resetForm clears Harga jual, so a following entry silently saves Jual 0 ('Jual: -'); merge also ignores entered Harga jual
critical_code_review_comments: stok-barang.tsx is 764 lines (>700) - split StatBox/MasukItem/RusakItem/Sheet/EditSheet/RusakSheet/styles into src/components/stok/*
EditSheet derives draft state during render via setState (lastId pattern) - works but fragile; prefer key={item.id} remount
Rusak records are delete-only (no edit), although card shows a pencil icon - pencil opens a detail sheet; consider info icon or allow editing jml/ket
Edit jenis is free text and renames only one row; pesanan items with old jenis no longer match FIFO

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; 2 minor data-integrity issues

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (python /app/backend/tests/seed_dashboard.py); test created TEST_D rows / TEST_busuk rusak, then reseeded at end to restore original seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed: belanja ba(TEST_A 6@10000), bb(TEST_B 5@20000), bc(TEST_C 10@5000), rusak r1(A,1), r2(C,2), supplier s1 TEST_Sup, 5 pesanan. Expected stok: tersedia 10, HPP tersedia 70.000, rusak 3, HPP rusak 20.000. Picker options testID picker-item-{value} (__BARU__, __KOSONG__, jenis, supplier id). Toast: toast-text (disappears ~2s). Note '[data-testid^=stok-item-]' also matches stok-item-count. Seeded orders have empty required Ekspor cells so unduh-excel download is blocked by validation.
